Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: 
Regulation 
30(6) 
of 
SEBI 
(Listing 
Obligations 
and 
Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Audio Recording of the Conference 
Call held with respects to the Unaudited Financial Results of the Bank for 
the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026 
****** 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that Audio Recording of the 
Conference Call held on 15th October 2026, at 6:00 P.M. (IST), in connection with 
the Unaudited Financial Results of the Bank for the Quarter and Half Year ended 
30th September 2026, is made available on the website of the Bank and can be 
accessed on the following link: 
 
https://www.kvb.bank.in/investor-corner/regulation-30-sebi-
disclosure/investor-con-call-transcripts-and-recordings/investor-con-call-
recordings/ 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
 
 
Srinivasa Rao Maddirala 
Company Secretary & 
Compliance Officer 
 
SRINIVASARAO 
MADDIRALA
Digitally signed by SRINIVASARAO 
MADDIRALA
